pages.title: Burns
pages.text: Burns are caused by various fire-related damage sources.

$(li)Affected Area$(li2)Whole body$(br)$(li)Effects$(li2)Direct damage to life$(li2)Moderate blood loss$(br)$(li)First Aid$(li2)Bandaging$(br)$(li)Treatment$(li2)Bandaging$(br)$(li)Notes$(li2)Bandages become dirty more quickly

pages.title: Open Wounds
pages.text: Open wounds are caused by various creature attacks.

$(li)Affected Area$(li2)Whole body$(br)$(li)Effects$(li2)Direct damage to life$(li2)Rapid blood loss$(br)$(li)First Aid$(li2)Bandaging$(br)$(li)Treatment$(li2)Suturing$(br)$(li)Notes$(li2)Requires immediate bleeding control

pages.title: Internal Injuries
pages.text: Internal injuries are caused by environmental damage or treatment issues.

$(li)Affected Area$(li2)Whole body$(br)$(li)Effects$(li2)Direct damage to life$(li2)Minor blood loss$(br)$(li)First Aid$(li2)None$(br)$(li)Treatment$(li2)Eating, tweezers during surgery to clean debris$(br)$(li)Notes$(li2)Minor internal injuries often require no attention

pages.title: Brain Damage
pages.text: Brain damage is caused by hypoxia due to major blood loss, respiratory arrest, shock, etc.
$(li)Affected Area$(li2)Head$(br)$(li)Effects$(li2)Direct damage to life$(br)$(li)First Aid$(li2)None$(br)$(li)Treatment$(li2)Treat the underlying cause$(br)

pages.title: Dislocation
pages.text: Dislocations are caused by internal injuries.
$(li)Affected Area$(li2)Limbs$(br)$(li)Effects$(li2)Severe limb pain$(br)$(li)First Aid$(li2)Bandaging$(br)$(li)Treatment$(li2)Correct with a wrench$(br)$(li)Notes$(li2)Impairs limb function

pages.title: Fracture
pages.text: Fractures are caused by internal injuries.

$(li)Affected Area$(li2)Whole body$(br)$(li)Effects$(li2)Severe limb pain$(br)$(li)First Aid$(li2)Bandaging$(br)$(li)Treatment$(li2)Full bandaging followed by gypsum casting, or bone fusion surgery$(br)

pages.title: Bleeding
pages.text: Bleeding is caused by wounds or unsealed surgical incisions.
$(li)Affected Area$(li2)Whole body$(br)$(li)Effects$(li2)Blood loss$(br)$(li)First Aid$(li2)Bandaging$(br)$(li)Treatment$(li2)Treat the underlying cause$(br)

pages.title: Respiratory Arrest
pages.text: Usually caused by severe shock reactions.
$(li)Affected Area$(li2)Chest$(br)$(li)Effects$(li2)Low oxygen levels$(br)$(li)First Aid$(li2)None$(br)$(li)Treatment$(li2)Treat the underlying cause$(br)

pages.title: Surgical Shock
pages.text: Surgical shock is caused by performing surgery without anesthesia.
$(li)Affected Area$(li2)Head$(br)$(li)Effects$(li2)Shock, brain damage$(br)$(li)First Aid$(li2)Use morphine for anesthesia$(br)$(li)Treatment$(li2)Stop the surgery$(br)

pages.title: Withdrawal
pages.text: Caused by opioid addiction.
$(li)Affected Area$(li2)Head$(br)$(li)Effects$(li2)Withdrawal symptoms$(br)$(li)First Aid$(li2)None$(br)$(li)Treatment$(li2)Anti-withdrawal medication (not implemented)
